scope: Preliminary benchmark: 8 hardcoded public prompts, 6 synthetic capability definitions, current Ask v2 prompt and Rust validator. No database data or saved user data was transmitted.
method: One streamed request per case; no repair retry. Wall time to model JSON plus validation. 3B, 8B and Gemini ran as independent sequential streams concurrently; 14B ran separately. Same max_tokens 4096, temperature 0, JSON-object response, latency routing. Gemini low reasoning; nonreasoning Ministral omitted reasoning setting.
limitations: Small single-run sample, not production or full-catalog performance.
Contract-valid does not mean semantically complete; smaller models also lost literal subjects, changed filters and misclassified optional fields.
Listed prices are current advertised token rates, not measured per-request billing.
